approvedConvention: Preserve existing namespace; use stable semantic camelCase suffixes; keep dynamic values as parameters; share only when owner, consumer and parameter contract match.

scope.consumer: app/app.js: renderHandleControlsFromData and handleOptions click feedback

rationale: Fixed instructions, accessible labels, priced-description composition, and selection feedback are grouped by the configurator handle owner. Catalog descriptions and handle labels remain parameters rather than being copied into fixed UI messages.
limitations: Proposal only; no product, canonical index, or decisions.json change.
The description template receives catalog-owned handleDescription and preformatted currency parameters; ownership/localization of catalog values remains separate.
The application announcement for applying a handle remains distinct from the stone-package announcement because the consumer and content owner differ.
